refingerprinted.why: The renderer moved from pokelike.core.render, shared with the CLI, to a copy frozen beside the harness. Source-identical for every function this harness calls, and the rendered text was checked byte for byte over 42 turns across 7 screen types, so what the model read is unchanged; bot.py changed in its import block only. The fingerprints are rewritten rather than left marked, because the mark would have claimed a change in what was measured. The old values are kept here so the swap is not silent.

bridge.js and init.js added to the record now that each harness carries its own. bridge.js is a byte-exact copy of the shared file as it stood when these runs played, taken from git rather than from today's, so it does NOT contain the node tooltips added afterwards. init.js is the same JavaScript that ran, which lived inside browser.py as a string; the file has a header comment added when it was extracted, so its bytes differ from what ran by that comment and nothing else. The three shared keys (browser.py, game.py, runner.py) are deliberately NOT recorded here: both moved when the scripts were extracted, so claiming today's hashes for a run from before would be false, and a key nobody recorded is a key nobody checks.

Every harness now records the tool calls it makes, which is what `pokelike model watch` and the decision trace read: a list appended to in the dispatch loop, plus in v2 two annotations on the notebook replies saying how full it was and what was refused. Nothing about the request, the reply the model reads, or any branch changed, so these scores describe what is on disk. Before this, only v4 recorded them and every earlier trace could not say whether a model had asked what was ahead or never looked.

leaderboard moved to pokelike.arena.leaderboard; the harness bot.py changed in its import block only. No behaviour change: render.py, bridge.js, init.js and the shared files are byte-identical. The fingerprint is rewritten rather than left marked, and the old value kept here, so the swap is not silent.

pythonic bot API rename (choose->act, on_start->reset, on_end->finish, rearrange->reorder, explain->reason, notes->metadata; LLMBot knobs->LLMConfig); behavior unchanged, verified by full pytest + identical live runs
